label: Devil A
identity_view: front, front-right oblique, right profile, rear-right oblique, back in row-major order
description: The exact native wingless long-armed devil creature: lean muscular ochre-brown pebbled hide, narrow waist, bent digitigrade legs and enormous low-hanging clawed hands with long separated bony fingers and ivory-gray hooked talons. Broad dark slate-violet plated chest and abdomen, matching dark slate tops of feet and pale short toe claws. Small broad reptilian head with a toothy horizontal mouth, pale fine teeth, pointed ears and brilliant yellow eyes with tiny pale centers. Preserve the exact native short head horns and long ivory-gray spikes rising behind the head and shoulders; several shorter spikes follow outer forearms, lower legs and the upper curve of the long thin tail. Preserve the native tail length, curled orientation and small spear-shaped tip, rough brown hide, dark chest, long forearms and disproportionately large hands. No wings, weapons, clothing, armor, extra horns or ornamental redesign. Keep the creature fully nonhuman and follow every native pose, silhouette and claw placement. Native green-teal and red hide variants will be derived offline, protecting gray chest plates, ivory spikes, claws, teeth and yellow eyes.
